text:
Sophie: Heads up — Sales just asked for a 24h temporary QPS uplift for org_927, they want 5x the per-key QPS. Campaign starts in ~2h. @Arjun @Marta any immediate blockers?
Arjun: What are the current limits?
Arjun: Per-org = 1000 QPS, per-key = 200 QPS, burst window = 30s. Pushing a single key to 1k QPS could saturate a slot and affect co-tenants.
Marta: We have a manual support flow that can set a TTL'd override in the rate-limit store (redis). It's called the temp_grant path. Historically manual approvals only.
Sophie: Sales wants fast lane — proposes soft bump first (2x) then escalate to 5x if green. Could we do staged enlargement plus conservative fallback routing? @Kai
Kai: Staged plan looks doable. My proposal: 1) create ephemeral exception on per-key with metadata (expires=24h;owner=sales), 2) enable burst-control so requests >1.5x are queued with a short retry, 3) automatic rollback if error-rate or latency degrades. Example command:
```bash
# create a short grant (staging)
support-cli grant-exception --org org_927 --qps 400 --ttl 4h --meta 'owner=sales,campaign=promo-22'
```
Ben: Need to ensure audit and cost gating. Also avoid noisy-neighbour effects — prefer routing the extra capacity to a reserved promo pool, otherwise other customers may see tail latency increase. Reserved pool costs money.
Sophie: Sales pushing to avoid Dedicated due to budget. If we do hosted uplift we should limit scope: per-key only, sampling of requests for telemetry, and a hard cap on CPU/GPU per-slot impact.
Arjun: Add an automated deny rule too — if we detect >50% of the key's traffic are embedding ops (expensive), block uplift. Also auto-revert if estimated bill > $2000 in 1h.
Marta: I'll approve a 2x soft bump manually via ticket #3456 so campaign can start. For the 5x escalation we need PM/ops signoff. I've created the support ticket and flagged finance.
support-bot: Audit entry registered — exception created by Marta for org_927: qps=400 TTL=4h ticket=3456 metadata=owner:sales,campaign:promo-22
Kai: I'll wire a temporary dashboard tile under Console -> Support -> TempExceptions showing qps, error-rate, and cost-estimates and add alerts at 0.5% error or 30% latency P95 increase. Pinging here once the config is live. :rocket:
Sophie: Thanks. If anyone sees a spike outside those thresholds, escalate to oncall and we'll roll back the grant instantly.
Ben: Also can we add a short-lived allowlist token so Sales can route debugging traffic separately? Minimizes impact to customer keys.
Marta: Good call — will add a promo token and attach same TTL.
Kai: Deploying config now; ETA ~15m. I'll post final status when done.
Sophie: Awesome — appreciate the quick turn.
